events.title: Shell's profit beats expectations at $6.9 billion, raises dividend by 5%
events.body:
STORY: Shell's first-quarter profit beat estimates and hit its highest in two years at $6.9 billion on Thursday.

It was boosted by gains linked to the Middle East war, leading the company to raise the dividend by 5%.
